title: Probing the Active Surface Sites for CO Reduction on Oxide-Derived Copper Electrocatalysts

extraction_issues.quote: Grain boundary density has also been correlated to CO2 and CO reduction catalytic activity on vapor-deposited nanocrystalline Au and Cu supported on carbon nanotubes. [cite XF]
extraction_issues.reason: 原文中出现了未处理的引用占位符[cite XF]，可能因排版或抽取过程丢失了具体文献编号。

extraction_issues.quote: When plotted against electrochemical activity, a linear correlation is obtained between specific CO reduction rate and the percentage of strong binding sites at the electrode surface (Fig 3f)
extraction_issues.reason: 图3的图注中f为TPD谱图叠加，g为CO还原活性对强结合位点比例的线性拟合；正文此处应引用Fig 3g而非Fig 3f。

self_check: 已核对关键数值：OD-Cu-500在-0.4 V时CO还原FE 48%；退火后比电流密度衰减6倍（200°C）和44倍（350°C）；粗糙因子51、24、14、6；晶界密度14±2 μm⁻¹和2.1±0.4 μm⁻¹；强结合位点比例11%、5%、1.5%；吸附能67 kJ/mol；线性相关关系。已确认图号引用错误及[cite XF]占位符。TPD模拟中强结合位点比例存在误差，原文也说明误差较大。未发现其他数值或结论不一致之处。
